items.title: Chico Hamilton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Alan, man, I was very impressed with Alan. Alan was a clean player, man. Everything he did, he made, he had tremendous finger control, man, and stick control.

ctx.x: I’m going to try to get there to interview Joe Harris that’s for sure. You were talking about Alan Dawson, how about his sterling student?

Alan, man, I was very impressed with Alan. Alan was a clean player, man. Everything he did, he made, he had tremendous finger control, man, and stick control. He got a good sound and rhythm man. He was dynamite, you know.
